title: Launcher abnormalRustExit attaches the Rust panic-journal summary to non-Rust or launcher-killed crashes
outcome: Launcher abnormalRustExit attaches the Rust panic-journal summary to non-Rust or launcher-killed crashes
acceptance: scripts/test-launcher.mjs attaches the panic-journal summary only to a stage that ran a Rust test binary (cargo or a termal test binary), and never to a non-Rust command that crashed or to a stage the launcher itself terminated (cancel or timeout), even when the run's journal exists; exit decisions are unchanged.
A launcher test covers a crashed non-Rust stage and a launcher-killed cargo stage with a journal present, and the review pair finds no Medium or higher.
